hero.subtext: I provide accurate, natural, and culturally adapted English–Brazilian Portuguese translation and interpreting services, helping individuals and businesses communicate clearly and confidently across languages. With a software engineering background and over 10 years of English language study, I bring a detail-oriented approach to every project.

about.p1: I'm Atyla (pronounced Ah-tee-lah) — I am a self-taught linguist from Brazil and I like studying foreign languages as a hobby.
about.p2: I started learning English when I was a teenager, not through any kind of formal education, but by simply watching <emphasis>way</emphasis> too much YouTube and playing Video-Games. Today, I am completely fluent in English.
about.p3: Currently, I'm studying Japanese and German. I also know a little bit of Russian. I want to be as fluent in these languages as I am now in English.

services.header: Translation services to help you<breakline/><highlight>reach your audience</highlight>.

translation.title: Translation & Localization
translation.description: I translate Documents, E-books, Websites, Video-Games, Technical Documentation, and whatever else you need translated.

proofreading.title: Proofreading
proofreading.description: Already got something translated, but you're not sure if it's grammatically and syntactically cohesive, or even if it is logically coherent? I can Proofread anything for you and help you get your ideas across in a professional and natural-sounding manner.

captioning.title: Video Captioning
captioning.description: Want your YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram videos to reach an overseas audience? I can caption your videos in both English and Portuguese

interpreting.title: Interpreting
interpreting.description: Got a Video call booked with a client, but can't speak a word of their language? I can interpret your conversation live, in real time.
